$comment: Cross-language size limits of the control-plane Session stream (issue #3360).
The SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for two numbers the API (Python) and the Worker (Go)
must agree on; each side holds its own constant and a test asserting it equals
the value here:
- api:    api/tests/fleet/test_control_message_size.py
- worker: worker/internal/adapters/controlplane/message_size_test.go and
worker/internal/application/instancemanager/files_properties_cap_test.go
max_file_bytes is the cap on a ReadFile result and an EditFile payload
(inclusive). max_message_bytes is the largest ENCODED WorkerMessage / ApiMessage
either side sends or accepts (inclusive); both sides set it as the gRPC max send
AND max receive message size, and check it before sending. It is max_file_bytes
plus 64 KiB for the envelope and the path, so a file at exactly the cap fits.
See docs/app/CONTROL_PLANE.md Section 3.1.
max_console_line_bytes is the cap on a ServerCommand line in UTF-8 bytes
(inclusive; issue #3363): the largest command body the game server's RCON
listener accepts in one packet (a 1,460-byte read minus 14 bytes of framing).
The API refuses a longer line at its HTTP edge and the Worker before it dials
RCON. Its tests:
- api:    api/tests/servers/test_lifecycle_endpoints.py
- worker: worker/internal/application/instancemanager/files_properties_cap_test.go
